Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

04:00 AM

You can cancel an order after placing it, but the window is short and it is time sensitive. Our customer service team can only process cancellations within approximately 30 minutes of the order being placed, and it is not guaranteed since some orders can ship the same day.

First, check your order confirmation email or order confirmation page to verify your current order status. If you use Gmail, also check your Promotions tab if you cannot find the email.

If the order has not yet shipped, call Shoebacca Customer Service immediately at 1-888-446-1788 (Monday–Friday: 7am–8pm CST, Saturday: 10am–6pm CST, Sunday: 12pm–6pm CST).

If the order has already shipped, cancellations are no longer possible. If that happens, you can follow the automated return process from your account page on shoebacca.com or from your order confirmation email.

Please leave your email address so the team can reach you.
